description: S46 T3 (MG5-reads): mcp.vocabulary {} serves the closed sets from the code that ENFORCES them — transports (mcp's own constants), rerun classes (internal/tools' — W16, never re-declared), effect classes, and the name grammars as REGEXP STRINGS taken from the validator's own variables. No params: the answer is a function of the compiled binary, and refusing it would claim the daemon cannot state facts it ships (policy.vocabulary's argument, carried). A UI form built from anything else drifts from the validator; built from this, an offered value is an accepted value (PM6's rule onto MCP).
